proposal:
SCOPE. Hand-derived; nothing executed. One unimplemented mechanism (FCF, form-code factorization), one growth invariant, one fixture for deployed v2. No completeness or polynomial-SAT claim.

DIAGNOSIS. (1) I decoded Neon 00034 by hand. With a,b,c,d the parities of the four variable triples, its first 96 clauses are (a|b)(~b|c)(a|~c)(~a|d)(b|~d)(~c|~d), which is unsatisfiable. The last 4 clauses are one even block on 8 variables with trivial stabilizer. The block spaces then span rank 12, so no projection exists, although six blocks still factor. So 'no reduction' means no global kernel, not no structure. (2) v2 requires every block space to be spanned by chosen forms inside it, i.e. a common adapted basis. Three block spaces span(f1), span(f2), span(f1+f2) admit none under any ordering, because a basis of their 2-dimensional sum has two elements. I recall (Polishchuk-Positselski, unchecked) that adapted bases exist exactly for distributive arrangements. An incompatibility skip therefore mixes greedy failure with intrinsic non-distributivity; better basis search repairs only the first.

MECHANISM (root only; Canon/SCC/IALH/DP unchanged).
1. For each exact-support block (S,P) compute the full stabilizer W. Since W lies inside P+p0, test |P| candidates by hashing: O(|P|^2 |S|) bit operations, no enumeration of 2^|S| points, no size cap.
2. Take the reduced-echelon basis l_1..l_k of the annihilator of W, k=|S|-dim W. Emit Q=pi(P), that is |P|/|W| clauses of width k, over form variables shared by all blocks using the same form. Blocks with W=0 are kept; their forms are coordinates.
3. Code constraint. Let Phi be the matrix of all distinct forms and R a row basis. For each dependent form emit y_phi = XOR of its R-expansion, as ternary XOR chains with fresh variables. No adapted basis, bijection or variable reduction is needed.
4. Certificate, polynomial in input bits: block forms independent; pi(P) inside Q; |P|=|Q|*2^(|S|-k), which forces P=pi^-1(Q); each dependency row rechecked on bitmasks; a matrix M with Phi_R M=I, lifting models by x=M y_R.
5. Accept iff total literals, chains included, strictly drop; otherwise leave v2 untouched.
Extra-clause variant (heuristic): with c(t)=#{p in P: p+t in P}, take W' spanned by high-count differences and split P into its W'-saturated core plus a residue kept verbatim. In the one-extra-point controls each block is one coset plus a point, so c(t)=|P|-1 on the old stabilizer and at most 2 elsewhere.

GROWTH INVARIANT. Order the form variables y_1..y_N and put lambda(i)=rank(Phi_<=i)+rank(Phi_>i)-rank(Phi). This is the connectivity function of the binary matroid of Phi, so it is unchanged by any invertible linear re-encoding of x. It equals the trellis state dimension of the code {Phi x}. With fib_B(i) the number of distinct fibers of Q_B across cut i, the number of semantically distinct residuals at cut i is at most 2^lambda(i) * prod_B fib_B(i). For Phi=identity lambda vanishes and this is the usual clause-cut bound.

INDEPENDENT-TEST PREDICTIONS FOR FCF (not v2).
P1. Neon 00034: 608 literals become 44; forms a,b,c,d plus eight coordinates, rank 12, no dependency rows; root SCC refutes; peak 0 against 16 observed.
P2. 96+6 control with the variant: 612 literals become 144; the binary core survives; peak 0 against 9.
P3. Fixture below: three unit clauses and one XOR row; unit propagation refutes.
A positive peak on any item falsifies it.

FIXTURE (v2). Three XOR equations x1+x2+x4+x5=1, x2+x3+x5+x6=1, x1+x3+x4+x6=1, 8 clauses each; their sum is 0=1. A rank-2 projection exists, but no adapted basis. Predicted: compression skipped for basis incompatibility, UNSAT, peak 0. By hand, if IALH returns UNKNOWN, DP eliminates 1,4,2,3,5,6 with clause counts 24,24,16,8,4,2 and never branches. My confidence in peak 0 is about 75 percent, because I do not know whether a branch-free DP refutation records a state. The skip reason is the informative observable; a positive peak would be a six-variable adversary.
missing_theorem:
T12.
(a) First missing piece: enumeration-free soundness for arbitrary n. Hypotheses per block: l_1..l_k independent, P duplicate-free, pi(P) contained in Q, |P|=|Q|*2^(|S|-k). Conclusion: for every x, F(x) holds iff every Q_B holds at Phi_B x. Adding that R is a row basis, each dependency row is an identity and Phi_R M=I: G is satisfiable iff F is, and x=M y_R is a model of F. This should be a Lean successor to CompressionSoundness; the only new ingredient is that fibers of a surjective F2-linear map have equal size. Checked by hand only.
(b) Stabilizer completeness and work: step 1 returns the exact stabilizer; total O(sum_B |P_B|^2 |S_B| + L n^2) bit operations for L input literals. Unwritten.
(c) Trellis bound for the deployed solver: if dependency rows are put in minimal-span form for the chosen order and chains follow that order, v2's syntactic residual count per layer is at most a constant times 2^lambda(i) * prod_B fib_B(i). The semantic version is classical trellis theory. The syntactic version depends on v2's dedup and pruning rules, which I have not seen. Conjecture.
(d) Explicitly not claimed: any polynomial bound on the minimum over orders of max_i (lambda(i) + sum_B log fib_B(i)). For distinct-support CNFs this is clause cut-width.
self_attack:
1. No-op on generic inputs. With pairwise distinct supports every stabilizer is trivial, Phi is the identity and FCF changes nothing. It is a normal form for parity-padded encodings, not a solver advance.
2. Ceiling. FCF plus DP stays inside a resolution-over-parities fragment, for which I recall exponential lower bounds (tree-like and regular Res(XOR); unchecked). Asymptotically good codes have linear trellis width under every order (recalled, unchecked), so lambda can itself be linear. Finding the best order is, I believe, NP-hard.
3. Dependency chains can hurt. They add variables and ternary XORs; v2's ascending fresh order need not be a low-lambda order, and the literal-drop test does not control peak. P1-P3 involve no long rows, so they do not test claim (c).
4. Discovery is exact only for per-block translation stabilizers. It misses covers of P by several affine subspaces (the one-point-perturbed gadget of auto00009), structure spread over different supports, and minimum-size factorization. The split variant is a threshold heuristic with no guarantee beyond single-coset blocks.
5. Fixture risk. It is tiny and probably easy for v2; it tests the skip classification, not growth. The peak prediction rests on my reading of the brief, not on source. I have not seen auto00008, so whether its skip is greedy or intrinsic is open.
6. Novelty. Trellis complexity, matroid connectivity and XOR extraction are standard.
mechanism_signature: FCF | unimplemented | root-only | per-block exact stabilizer from |P| candidate translations | shared form variables + explicit linear-code dependency rows (no adapted basis, no bijection, no variable-reduction requirement) | counting certificate |P|=|Q|*2^(|S|-k), no 2^n enumeration | accept iff literal count drops | invariant: lambda(i) = matroid connectivity of forms = trellis state dimension, affine-invariant | incomplete: distinct supports, affine covers, cross-support structure
delta_from_prior: PMD (00032) reached a bijective re-encoding by single pivots under greedy literal descent, stalled on overlapping forms, and offered only the negative remark that the deployed peak is not affine-invariant. FCF computes each block's stabilizer directly, drops the bijection requirement by carrying dependent forms through explicit XOR rows, replaces the per-clause substitution lemma by a counting certificate, and supplies a width that is affine-invariant. When the forms are independent and number n, FCF's output coincides with a PMD fixed point. Relative to deployed v2 it removes the adapted-basis and strict-reduction requirements and the 2^n check. I hold only truncated summaries of 00028-00031, so overlap with RAQ's root repair cannot be excluded. New evidence used: the 00032 receipt (binary core refuted at root inside a mixed formula, peak 0), on which P1 and P2 rely, and my hand decoding of Neon 00034.
